item.title: 1969 Rover 2000 TC 4-Speed Project at No Reserve

item.title: 2001 Mitsubishi Montero Limited
item.description: This 2001 Mitsubishi Montero Limited remained registered in Puerto Rico until 2018, and it was acquired by the selling dealer in 2024 following single-family ownership. item.description: This 1985 Mazda RX-7 GS was registered in Ohio, Michigan, and Wisconsin before being acquired by the seller on BaT in November 2023, and it now shows 59k miles. item.title: 2007 Porsche Boxster S 6-Speed at No Reserve
item.description: This 2007 Porsche Boxster S is an Atlas Gray Metallic convertible powered by a 3.4-liter flat-six linked with a six-speed manual transaxle. The car is equipped with a black soft top, 18″ Boxster S wheels, a rear spoiler, black leather upholstery, heated power-adjustable seats, a CD stereo, a Bose sound system, and cruise control. This 987.1 Boxster S was purchased by the current owner on BaT in November 2025 and is now offered at no reserve in New York on consignment by the previous selling deal

item.title: 2014 Audi A6 TDI Prestige
item.description: This 2014 Audi A6 TDI Prestige was purchased new by the seller's sister, and the family has since added 107k miles while registering the car in California. It is finished in Aviator Blue Metallic over Black leather and is powered by a turbodiesel 3.0-liter V6 linked with an eight-speed Tiptronic automatic transaxle and a Quattro all-wheel-drive system. item.description: This 2000 Porsche 911 Carrera is a Japanese-market coupe that was imported to the US in June 2025 and was acquired by the selling dealer later that year. Finished in black over Graphite Grey leather, the car is powered by a 3.4-liter M96 flat-six paired with a six-speed manual transaxle. item.description: This 2013 Maserati GranTurismo Sport convertible was sold new through Maserati of Atlanta and remained registered in Georgia with the original owner until 2025. item.title: 2023 McLaren Artura
item.description: This 2023 McLaren Artura was originally delivered to Texas and spent time in Arizona and Nevada prior to its acquisition by the selling dealer in January 2026. Power comes from a twin-turbocharged 3.0-liter V6 mated to an Axial Flux electric motor and an eight-speed dual-clutch transaxle.
